description.value:
No matter how advanced your inventions become, you never neglect the basics. In fact, you've even developed a few improvements to enhance some old favorites.

  • Whenever you apply the big boom mod to an item, you increase the item's radius by 10 feet if it's a burst or a cone (rather than by 5 feet), and its area by 20 feet if it's a line (rather than 10 feet).

  • Whenever you apply the bunker buster mod to an item, you increase the additional damage by 5 (for a total of 10 additional damage, rather than 5).

  • Whenever you apply the incapacitant mod to an item, creatures damaged by the item additionally become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.Frightened]{Frightened 1} if the attack was a critical hit or they critically failed their save.

  • Whenever you apply the long-range propulsors mod to an item, you increase the item's range or range increment by 60 feet (rather than by 30 feet).

  • Whenever you apply the magnetic levitators mod to an item, the wearer gains a fly Speed of 20 feet (rather than a fly Speed of 10 feet).

  • Whenever you apply the troubleshoot mod to an item, you reduce its glitching condition by 2 (rather than by 1).
